principle: EVIDENCE EARNS ACTIVATION. No evidence -> no activation. Weak -> shadow only. Strong but incomplete -> CERTIFICATION_PASSED. Strong, stable, chronology-safe AND prospectively confirmed -> PRODUCTION_ELIGIBLE. PRODUCTION_ACTIVE is never set by research.
unit_of_candidate: feature family x position x decision(START_SIT). Consumer scope is START_SIT only.

lanes.TRUE_AS_OF: immutable pre-kickoff FI snapshot + captured pre-kickoff production baseline. Exists only for 2026 live captures (currently 0 qualifying weeks).
lanes.RECONSTRUCTED_CHRONOLOGY_SAFE: FI features rebuilt from primitives truncated at week W-1 (AS_OF discontinuity mode); target/actuals never predictors. Used for 2021-2025.
lanes.CURRENT_REBUILD_NOT_HISTORICAL: today's FI files applied to the past. NEVER used as evidence.

baselines.PRIMARY: baseline_sleeper = Sleeper weekly projection history (RotoWire-backed). Production's actual baseline projection is 'sleeper-weekly-rotowire'; the historical series is a RECONSTRUCTED_PRODUCTION_LIKE baseline (2021 no timestamp, 2022 bulk-backfilled, 2023-25 revision-possible). It is NOT the historical production output and is never called that.
baselines.NAIVE_CONTROL: baseline_trailing = exponentially weighted trailing PPG of prior completed weeks (half-life 4). Reported for context only. Certification is NEVER decided against the naive control.
baselines.consequence: Because no lane provides a captured pre-kickoff production baseline for historical weeks, historical evidence alone can never justify PRODUCTION_ELIGIBLE. Highest state reachable from historical evidence = CERTIFICATION_PASSED.

chronology.training_seasons: strictly earlier than the evaluated season

holdout.rule: touched exactly once, only for candidates that passed ALL development gates; parameters (beta, lambda, tau, cap) frozen and committed before the holdout is read

chronology.evaluation_rows: test-season rows only; 2021/2022 rows are TRAINING ONLY (their baseline vintage is the weakest)
chronology.weeks: 4-17 (>=3 played weeks of trailing form exist)

candidate_model.target: residual = actual - baseline_sleeper (per scoring archetype: std, half, ppr separately fitted)
candidate_model.single_family_translation: adjustment = clip(beta * z * cw, -cap*|baseline|, +cap*|baseline|); z = (x - mean_train)/sd_train; cw = served confidence weight (HIGH 1, MEDIUM .5, LOW .2, INSUFFICIENT 0) x prior-dominated haircut 0.6
candidate_model.beta: ridge on the sum scale: sum(u*r)/(sum(u^2)+lambda), u = z*cw; lambda chosen from {0, 100, 1000, 10000} on the latest prior season only
candidate_model.tau_selection: maximise pooled development-fold mean close-call regret improvement subject to >= 100 reversals; then frozen
candidate_model.families_evaluated: every PREDICTIVE / WEAKLY_PREDICTIVE family listed for the position in analysis/football_intel_startsit/config.R SS$POSITION_FAMILIES (QB 7, RB 8, WR 9, TE 6 = 30 tests)

not_evaluated.PFR pressure / NGS / coverage-unit / FTN: no reconstructable as-of historical series in the decision dataset -> NOT_EVALUABLE -> remain SHADOW_ONLY / DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY

candidate_model.combination_rule: ablation first (baseline + family X). A position bundle of the surviving families is evaluated only after individual results and can never promote a family that failed individually.

decision_evaluation.unit: same-position player pairs within (season, week, position, archetype), both with baseline and actual
decision_evaluation.close_call_region: |baseline edge| < tau; outside it FI may not flip a decision
decision_evaluation.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap over (season, week) clusters, 2000 resamples, seed 20260921, 90% interval

gates.G1_chronology: training seasons < test season; lane RECONSTRUCTED_CHRONOLOGY_SAFE; future-mutation invariance test passes
gates.G2_sample: each development fold >= 12 weeks and >= 1000 rows; pooled development reversals >= 300; holdout reversals >= 100. Failure => RESEARCH_ELIGIBLE (inconclusive), not FAILED
gates.G3_incremental_value: pooled development MAE improvement >= +0.03 fantasy points AND 90% CI lower bound > 0 AND Benjamini-Hochberg q <= 0.10 across all 30 candidate tests
gates.G4_stability: MAE improvement > 0 in BOTH development folds and in EACH scoring archetype pooled
gates.G5_decision_value: pooled development mean close-call regret improvement > 0 with 90% CI lower bound > 0; reversal win rate >= 0.52; severe-miss rate on reversals <= large-win rate
gates.G6_holdout: 2025 holdout: MAE improvement >= +0.03 with 90% CI lower bound > 0 AND close-call regret improvement > 0 with 90% CI lower bound > 0 (Bonferroni over the number of holdout-tested candidates)
gates.G7_calibration: calibration slope of realised residual on predicted adjustment in [0.5, 1.5] with 90% CI lower bound > 0; quintile-mean residual monotone (Spearman >= 0.6)
gates.G8_subgroup_harm: no archetype, season-half (wk 4-9 / 10-17) or baseline-level tercile cell whose 90% CI upper bound of MAE improvement is < -0.03
gates.G9_redundancy: reported: |corr(z, baseline_sleeper)| and |corr(z, baseline_trailing)|; a family whose signal is >= 0.9 correlated with the baseline cannot claim incremental value
gates.G10_to_G15: temporal identity, scoring contract, freshness (canonical evaluator, family-level), source quality, family isolation, consumer scope, reversibility, lineage: verified by deterministic tests, not by data

state_rules.SHADOW_ONLY -> RESEARCH_ELIGIBLE: family is PREDICTIVE/WEAKLY_PREDICTIVE and has a reconstructable as-of historical series (evaluable)
state_rules.RESEARCH_ELIGIBLE -> CERTIFICATION_FAILE: adequate sample (G2) but any of G3-G8 failed (including 'effectively zero' improvement)
state_rules.RESEARCH_ELIGIBLE -> CERTIFICATION_PASSE: G1-G9 all pass on development AND holdout
state_rules.CERTIFICATION_PASSED -> PRODUCTION_ELIGI: prospective gate below AND freshness/readiness/reversibility/lineage tests pass
state_rules.PRODUCTION_ELIGIBLE -> PRODUCTION_ACTIVE: NEVER by research. Explicit human-reviewed merge/deploy with an activation_log entry.

prospective_gate.derivation: Derived from FI Start/Sit, not copied from Phase 5. Historical close-call reversals occur in ~3% of pairs and per-reversal outcome SD is ~3-4 fantasy points, so n=150 reversal-eligible decisions gives a standard error of ~0.3 points, the smallest effect worth acting on.
requires: existing evidence gate (evidence-gate-2026.2): >= 4 qualifying 2026 weeks (NFL week COMPLETE, FI as-of buildable, actuals final, pre-kickoff production baseline captured)
>= 150 live-captured reversal-eligible decisions for the candidate family x position across >= 3 distinct weeks
prospective mean regret improvement point estimate >= 0
prospective_gate.current_state: 0 qualifying weeks, 0 live-captured decisions (verified in Checkpoint A)

multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg (q<=0.10) over the 30 development tests; holdout tests Bonferroni-corrected over survivors. Effect size and stability outrank p-values.
safety_bounds: Cap 0.25 x |baseline| retained as an upper bound only; the certified cap for any eligible family must be the smallest of {0.25, evidence-supported fraction}. Tie-break-only usage (|edge| < tau) is mandatory unless evidence shows benefit outside the close-call region.
immutability: This file is committed before evaluate.R is run. Any change after results are visible must be a NEW criteria_version with the reason recorded; the original is never edited.
